name: Grammarly
description: Grammarly is an AI writing assistant, described as "an AI partner that helps turn your thoughts into writing," offering grammar correction, tone adjustment, and AI-generated content across browsers, desktop, mobile, and productivity apps.
best_for: Individuals wanting free or Pro tiers for personal writing improvement, teams and businesses needing brand-voice consistency and AI prompts, and enterprises requiring data loss prevention and dedicated support.
features: Grammar, spelling, and clarity correction with full-sentence rewrites
AI-generated content creation with a monthly prompt allowance
Plagiarism detection and AI-generated text detection
Brand voice and style-guide consistency for teams
Browser extensions (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge) and desktop apps (Windows, Mac)
Integrations with Google Docs, Microsoft Office, and Slack

alternatives.name: ChatGPT
alternatives.description: OpenAI's general-purpose AI assistant, usable for drafting, editing, and rewriting text.
alternatives.best_for: Users wanting a flexible assistant for writing tasks rather than a dedicated grammar/style checker.

alternatives.name: Copy.ai
alternatives.description: An AI-native go-to-market platform for generating sales, marketing, and operations content.
alternatives.best_for: GTM teams producing high-volume marketing and sales copy rather than everyday writing correction.

alternatives.name: Jasper
alternatives.description: An AI platform purpose-built for marketing teams with brand-governed content generation.
alternatives.best_for: Marketing teams needing on-brand content at scale rather than individual writing assistance.
